name: tickbell
description: TickBell 2.0 — Multi-channel reminder system supporting Cloudflare Workers + D1 one-click deploy and self-hosted Docker + SQLite

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:node
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tickbell/core typecheck && pnpm --filter tickbell-worker typecheck && pnpm --filter tickbell-node typecheck && pnpm --filter tickbell-web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @tickbell/core test && pnpm --filter tickbell-worker test && pnpm --filter tickbell-node test && pnpm --filter tickbell-web test
